metadata.protocol: Eleven singleton/path/star controls and 24 matching-rich proposals: orders 32,64,128; four base families; one or two pair-expansion levels. External matched-pair endpoints and vertex presentations are seeded. Exact isomorphism classes are deduplicated before search. All inputs are frozen before outcomes. Matching existence is independently checked with NetworkX maximum matching. This functional experiment may run concurrently with other work: elapsed time is logged for provenance, not compared as a performance result. No default solver changes or novelty claims.
